# Brain Modules & Spines Catalog

## Brain Modules

| Id                     | Kind     | Description                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `hunger-drive`         | utility  | Converts normalized energy deficit into a nonlinear foraging urge and broadcasts hormone.satiety.                    |
| `seek-gradient`        | rule     | Steers toward a visual target or stereo olfactory gradient, outputting a behavior bundle and close-range bite pulse. |

| `fox-hunt-prey`        | rule     | Species-specific predator pursuit module chasing visible prey or prey scent and triggering close-range bites.        |
| `rabbit-flee-predator` | rule     | Species-specific herbivore flight reflex steering away from visual/olfactory predators and pain spikes.              |
